taxonomy:
# Taxonomy of Grid-Based Logic Puzzles

## I. By Primary Task Type

### A. Loop Drawing
*Draw a single continuous loop through the grid*

- **Masyu** – loop constrained by black/white circle turning rules
- **Slitherlink** – loop drawn on grid edges, constrained by number clues
- **Mid-loop** – loop where black circles must be midpoints of straight segments
- **Dotchi-Loop** – loop through white circles (straight or turn per region); avoids black circles
- **Moon-or-Sun** – loop alternates between moon rooms and sun rooms
- **Nagareru** – directional loop affected by wind constraints
- **Suraromu** – loop starting/ending at numbered circle, passing through all gates in order
- **Yajilin** – loop with black cells placed; arrow clues indicate black cell counts

### B. Path/Line Drawing (Non-loop)
*Draw paths or lines that are not necessarily loops*

- **Numberlink** – connect pairs of identical numbers with non-crossing paths
- **Hashiwokakero** – connect island circles with bridges (1 or 2); all connected, no crossings
- **Pencils** – draw lines from pencil tips through cells, with length constraints

### C. Cell Shading / Painting
*Determine which cells to color black (or leave white)*

#### C1. Shading with number clues about adjacent/surrounding black cells
- **Akari** – place light bulbs; numbers on black squares indicate adjacent bulb count
- **Kurotto** – numbers in circles = sum of contiguous black cell groups touching the circle
- **Nurikabe** – numbers define white island sizes; black cells form one connected wall, no 2×2
- **Nurimisaki** – circles mark promontory cells; numbers indicate white line length; no 2×2 black or white
- **Kurodoko** – numbers = count of visible white cells in four directions; black cells don't touch; white connected
- **Usowan** – numbers show adjacent colored cells, but one number per room is wrong; no adjacent colored cells; white connected

#### C2. Shading with region/room constraints
- **Heyawake** – rooms with numbers dictating black cell count; no white line spans 3+ rooms; black cells don't touch; white connected
- **Norinori** – exactly two black cells per region, each part of a domino; dominoes may cross region boundaries
- **Nuritwin** – each region has exactly two same-sized shaded blocks; all shaded connected; no 2×2 shaded
- **LITS** – place one tetromino per region; same-shape tetrominoes don't share edges; all shaded connected; no 2×2
- **Sto-stone** – rooms with numbered black cell groups; black cells don't connect across rooms; when "dropped" they fill bottom half
- **Tilepaint** – entire tiles colored or not; diagonal clue cells specify black cell counts in rows/columns
- **Nurimeizu** – entire rooms painted or not; creates maze from S to G; circles on shortest path, triangles not

#### C3. Shading forming rectangles/squares
- **Choco Banana** – black groups must be rectangles/squares; white groups must not be rectangles/squares; numbers indicate group size
- **Shakashaka** – place triangles so remaining white areas form rectangles/squares; numbers indicate adjacent triangle count

### D. Cell Coloring / Elimination (from given numbers)
*Blacken or eliminate cells containing pre-filled numbers*

- **Hitori** – black out duplicate numbers so none repeats in any row/column; black cells don't touch; white connected

### E. Number/Symbol Placement
*Fill empty cells with numbers or symbols*

#### E1. Region-based number filling
- **Sudoku** – fill 1–9 in rows, columns, and 3×3 blocks
- **Fillomino** – fill numbers; blocks of same number sized to match; same-sized blocks don't touch
- **Ripple Effect** – rooms filled with 1 to room-size; same numbers in a line must be spaced apart ≥ the number
- **Makaro** – rooms filled 1 to room-size; arrows in black cells point to largest neighbor; same numbers don't adjoin across rooms
- **Nansuke** – fill blank cells using a given list of multi-digit numbers

#### E2. Symbol placement
- **Juosan** – fill every cell with — or |; territory numbers constrain the difference; no 3+ consecutive same symbols in restricted direction

### F. Grid Division / Partitioning
*Divide the grid into regions or blocks*

- **Shikaku** – divide into rectangles, each containing exactly one number equal to rectangle area
- **Five Cells** – divide into pentominoes; numbers indicate surrounding block-edge count
- **Double Choco** – divide into blocks each containing matching white and gray shapes; numbers indicate cells of that color
- **Sashigane** – divide into L-shaped blocks; circles mark bends; arrows mark endpoints pointing to bends; numbers indicate block size

### G. Shading + Block Shape Constraints
- **Chained Block** – shade cells into "blocks" (connected groups); each block has one number/? indicating its size; blocks chain at corners; no duplicate shape per chain
- **Evolomino** – place squares on arrows forming blocks; successive blocks along an arrow grow by one cell without rotation/flip

### H. Object Movement
*Move objects within the grid*

- **Satogaeri** – move numbered circles so each country has one; number = cells traversed; paths don't cross
- **Yosenabe** – move all circles into gray areas via straight arrows; arrows don't cross; gray area numbers = sum of entering circle values

### I. Specialized Placement
- **Hebi** – place snakes (1–5 sequences) in white cells; snakes can't touch; line-of-sight attack rule from head direction

---

## II. By Constraint Mechanism

### Connectivity constraints (white/black cells must be connected or form walls)
Akari, Heyawake, Hitori, Kurodoko, Nurikabe, Nurimisaki, Nuritwin, LITS, Usowan, Yajilin, Nurimeizu

### No 2×2 constraint (no 2×2 block of same color)
Nurikabe, Nurimisaki, Nuritwin, LITS, Nurimeizu, Sto-stone

### Adjacency prohibition (black/colored cells can't share edges)
Hitori, Heyawake, Usowan, Yajilin, Kurodoko, Norinori (partial—dominoes required)

### Numbered regions/rooms
Heyawake, Makaro, Ripple Effect, Double Choco, Five Cells, Sto-stone, Nuritwin, Nurimeizu, Shakashaka, Akari

### Directional/arrow clues
Yajilin, Makaro, Hebi, Sashigane, Nagareru, Yosenabe, Pencils, Evolomino

### Visibility/line-of-sight clues
Akari (illumination), Kurodoko (white cell count), Hebi (snake attack), Nurimisaki (white line length)

---

## III. By Grid Element Used for Clues

### Numbers in cells
Sudoku, Fillomino, Ripple Effect, Hitori, Nansuke, Makaro, Shikaku, Five Cells, Choco Banana, Chained Block, Sto-stone, Nuritwin

### Numbers on black squares or in circles
Akari, Kurotto, Kurodoko, Nurikabe, Nurimisaki, Hashiwokakero, Satogaeri, Yosenabe, Suraromu

### Numbers with arrows
Yajilin, Hebi, Makaro, Pencils

### Circles (black/white) without numbers
Masyu, Mid-loop, Dotchi-Loop

### Symbols (moon/sun)
Moon-or-Sun

### Diagonal line cells
Tilepaint

### Bold-line regions
Heyawake, Double Choco, Norinori, Makaro, Ripple Effect, Five Cells, Moon-or-Sun, Dotchi-Loop, Sto-stone, Nuritwin, Nurimeizu, Usowan, LITS, Satogaeri, Juosan
